issues.description: The template for Aufgabe 01 uses a broad SELECT * (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql:1) while the problem statement explicitly requires outputting exactly the columns id, name, art and url (problem_statement.md:108-109). The solution also selects those specific columns (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql:1). The SELECT * in the template contradicts the stated requirement and may encourage students to submit queries that return extra columns, which the automatic checks will mark as incorrect and therefore confuse or mislead students.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the broad SELECT * in template_repository/aufgabe01.sql with a starter that matches the required columns (for example: SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad; or provide an empty SELECT line with a comment reminding students to select exactly the required columns). This keeps the template structurally consistent with the problem statement and the solution while still leaving the task for students to complete.
